scope: Bounded primary-source comparison, not exhaustive priority review

sources.title: Efficient ground-state energy estimation and certification on early fault-tolerant quantum computers
sources.authors: Guoming Wang; Daniel Stilck França; Gumaro Rendon; Peter D. Johnson
sources.role: Direct explicit future question about certification sample overhead. Estimator and certifier require different promises; QET-U function block-encodings are not hidden.
sources.limits: Not a sample lower bound; not an unconditional small-depth guarantee; eta and a coarse interval are still required.

sources.title: Heisenberg-limited ground state energy estimation for early fault-tolerant quantum computers
sources.role: Hadamard/Fourier-CDF inversion is a D1-compatible baseline and a charged coarse-estimation option.
sources.limits: No transcript or implementation executed; no new overlap certificate obtained.

sources.title: Even shorter quantum circuit for phase estimation on early fault-tolerant quantum computers with applications to ground-state energy estimation
sources.read_scope: Introduction; Theorems2/3 and Corollary4; relative-overlap definition
sources.role: Known short-depth alternative under strong overlap or filter-window relative-overlap promises.
sources.limits: Do not give its relative-overlap or window-location conditions to a new method for free.

sources.title: Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Algorithms in Practice: Application to Ground-State Energy Estimation
sources.read_scope: Sections3-4: inflection/changepoint target, precision caveat, low-energy accumulation bound
sources.role: Distinguish a detected low-energy accumulation from a universal absolute-ground acceptance certificate.
sources.limits: Numerical sections/source not reproduced or reanalyzed; no claim of general impossibility.

sources.title: Statistical Quantum Phase Estimation: Extensions and Practical Considerations
sources.read_scope: SectionIII; SectionIV-B and Algorithm5; comparison to eta-dependent binary-search guarantee
sources.role: Current follow-up uses changepoint detection without selecting eta from input.
sources.limits: No matched all-input unknown-gap soundness/completeness/cost theorem identified in inspected sections; numerical evidence not an impossibility result.

sources.title: Optimal Quantum Algorithm for Ground-State Energy Estimation with a Guiding State
sources.role: Current transducer query-optimal comparator with controlled A/A-dagger and U/U-dagger.
sources.limits: Total query optimality is not a theorem about independent bounded-time Hadamard records or molecular finite native resources.

sources.title: Optimal Lower Bound for Ground-State Energy Estimation with a Guiding State
sources.authors: Rolando D. Somma; Ronald de Wolf
sources.read_scope: Sections1.1-1.2; Theorem3.1 and its oracle/dimension conditions
sources.role: Matching general guided-query lower bound screens out a stale generic overlap/precision question.
sources.limits: No transfer of arbitrary diagonal-oracle hard family to known electronic-integral inputs proved here.

sources.title: Optimal Ground-State Preparation with a Guiding State
sources.authors: Stacey Jeffery; Rolando D. Somma; Freek Witteveen; Ronald de Wolf
sources.role: Latest follow-up check: preparation task with energy/gap promises, not a replacement unknown-gap energy test
sources.limits: Full text and implementation not obtained/read in this survey; no claim beyond abstract conditions

sources.title: Certifying ground-state properties of quantum many-body systems
sources.authors: Jie Wang; Jacopo Surace; Irénée Frérot; Benoît Legat; Marc-Olivier Renou; Victor Magron; Antonio Acín
sources.read_scope: SectionsI-II: variational upper bounds and SDP lower bounds; fermionic extension scope
sources.role: Classical coefficient-aware certificates must remain in B_fair.
sources.limits: Examples are not a universal finite-cost closing guarantee for all electronic Hamiltonians; no SDP run or new certificate constructed.
